CITY OF LA VERNE
  DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE
  ACTION MINUTES

Eric Scherer, Chair  City Hall
Cody Howing, City Engineer  3660 “D” Street
Meg McWade, Public Works  La Verne, CA 91750
  (909) 596-8706
  www.cityoflaverne.org

  Tuesday, September 3, 2024 – 9:00 a.m.
  City Hall Council Chambers
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Development Review Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Development Review Committee
with valuable information. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st Tuesday of every month. In
compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s
Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The Council Chambers will be open to the public at 9:00 a.m. Materials related to an item on this
agenda, submitted to the Development Review Committee after distribution of the agenda packet,
are available for public inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during
normal business hours.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  Mr. Scherer called the meeting to order at 9:00 a.m.

  Voting members present: Eric Scherer, Cody Howing and Meg McWade

  Others present: Principal Planner Candice Bowcock, Assistant Planner Gabriel
  Rivera, Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow and Fire Marshal Fred St. Ange

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Development Review
  Committee on items not listed in any other place on this agenda.
 Development Review Committee Action Minutes - September 3, 2024
Page 2

  California Law does not allow the Development Review Committee to take action in
  response to your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to
  staff or set for hearing at a later date.

  None

  3. APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES – June 25, 2024 and July 2, 2024

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Ms. McWade to approve the minutes
  as submitted. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  4. PROJECT REVIEWS
  Note: Due to time constraints, discussion on these items will be limited to 30
  minutes each.

  A.  PROJECT:  VARIANCE TO ALLOW FOR A PORCH AND
  ADDITIONS FOR A SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE
  WITH A SUBSTANDARD GARAGE
  CASE NO:  46-24VAR
  ADDRESS:  2435 MAGNOLIA AVE
  Project Planner:  Gabriel Rivera

  Deposit Project #: PL1434
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicants Brian and Natalie Bustamante were present at the
  meeting.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Ms. McWade to recommend
  approval to the Planning Commission. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  B.  PROJECT:  REQUEST TO REDUCE THE REQUIRED TREE
  REPLACEMENT, A CONDITION OF APPROVAL FOR
  THE GRANTING OF A PERMIT TO REMOVE TWO
  SIGNIFICANT HERITAGE TREES
  CASE NO:  83-24TR
  ADDRESS:  7215 MONTEREY ST
  Project Planner:  Parker Stringfellow

  Deposit Project #: PL1439
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicants Firas and Janelle Totri were present at the meeting.
  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Ms. McWade to approve
  Case No. 83-24TR. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  2

Page 3

  C.  PROJECT:  EXPANSION OF AN AUTOMOTIVE SERVICE SHOP
  AND PARCEL MERGER AT B&M TOWING AND TIRE
  REPAIR
  CASE NOS:  97-24CUP, 98-24PPR, 99-24PM
  ADDRESS:  1974 & 1978 ARROW HWY
  Project Planner:  Gabriel Rivera

  Deposit Project #: PL1440
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicants Mike Sandoval and Yolanda D’Oyen were present at
  the meeting.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Ms. McWade to approve
  Case Nos. 98-24PPR and 99-24PM with added conditions regarding L.I.D.
  and ADA and recommend approval of Case No. 97-24CUP to the Planning
  Commission. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  D.  PROJECT:  LARIOS EXPANSION AND FRONT FAÇADE
  ALTERATION
  CASE NO:  104-24PPR
  ADDRESS:  1912 ARROW HWY
  Project Planner:  Candice Bowcock and Valerie Chin

  Deposit Project #: PL1428
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The following were present at the meeting: Alondra Lopez, Carolina
  Henao, Jorge Larios Jr., Jorge Larios Sr., Herlinda Larios, and Diana Larios.

  It was moved by Mr. Howing and seconded by Ms. McWade to approve
  Case No. 104-24PPR. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

  5. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:45 a.m. The next meeting of the Development
  Review Committee is scheduled to be held on October 1, 2024 at 9:00 a.m. at City
  Hall, 3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Natalie Hiatt, Administrative Secretary
